question: Is an INT8 decode KV copy (int8_per_token_head, the gufo-matching representation) retainable for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on gfx1151 under the production numerical gate?

decision.binding_number: int8_per_token_head fp16 at 4096/16 fails the repeated-token control mixed_v1: mean KL 0.1597 > 0.05 (max 2.6939, top-1 0.9412)
decision.calibrated_envelope_note: even at 1024/8 the aggregate mean KL 3.47e-3 exceeds the calibrated 1e-3 limit
decision.runtime: non-blocking: INT8 eager >= BF16 graph at all depths; INT8 graph fastest
decision.memory: non-blocking: -49.6% retained KV, -0.101 GiB run peak, zero BF16 mirror

host.name: gfx1151
host.note: Physical Framework Desktop host; independent lane from the W7900 gfx1100 KV results.

software.source_tree_state: no edits under hipengine/ or kernels/ during the run

protocol.stop_rule: stop a representation after its first failed shape
protocol.note: Timings in the screening runs are diagnostic only; the retained runtime comparison is runtime.json.

binding_failure.mechanism: Single-position event, not diffuse drift: 17 positions, summed KL 2.7142 against a max of 2.6939, so 99.25% of the per-prompt KL mass sits at position 4 where the reference top-1 is 271 and the candidate top-1 is 30523; the other 16 positions average 1.27e-3. The control is a repeated 36-token unit, so its reference distributions are near-one-hot and one rank flip costs KL ~2.7.

natural_prompt_outcome.512/8: 10/10 natural prompts pass; worst prompt mean KL 1.223e-3 (mixed_ja_en_translate), min top-1 1.0
natural_prompt_outcome.1024/8: 10/10 natural prompts pass; worst prompt mean KL ~1.3e-3, min top-1 1.0
natural_prompt_outcome.4096/16: 10/10 natural prompts pass at 100% top-1 with mean KL <= 1.09e-3 (code 3.1e-4, general_en 2.4e-4, general_ja 7.1e-4, mixed_ja_en 1.0e-3)
natural_prompt_outcome.reading: The 35B route is materially better behaved on natural prompts than the gfx1151 27B route, which rejected at 1024/8 with a failing natural prompt (mixed_ja_en_review). The 35B blocker is confined to the synthetic repeated-token control.

why_not_promoted: The declared gate requires every prompt in the suite to pass, and mixed_v1 is in the suite. Waiving it for this artifact would apply a weaker gate to a second model than the one that closed the gfx1151 27B lane, and the measured upside does not justify re-cutting the gate: the runtime gain is +1.44%/+1.50%/+1.59% at depths 0/4096/16384 (flat, not widening) and the net owned-session memory reduction is 146,761,728 B (0.64%) at 18,688 retained rows. See runtime.json and memory.json.
